connector.name: Tube Search MCP
connector.registryDescription: Search archived YouTube videos including deleted, private, or region-blocked content.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tube-search-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the archivarix-com account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TUBE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Archivarix Tube Search. Obtain at https://tube.archivarix.net/profile (Plus tier or API tier required).
